lines.en: The clouds are holding a meeting. Could go either way.
lines.af: Die wolke hou 'n vergadering. Kan enige kant toe gaan.
lines.zu: Amafu abambe umhlangano. Isinqumo singaba yebo noma cha.
lines.xh: Amafu abambe intlanganiso. Isigqibo sinokuba ewe okanye hayi.
lines.st: Maru a tshwere seboka. Qeto e ka ba ee kapa tjhe.

lines.en: Highveld clouds this heavy by two o'clock don't bluff.
lines.af: Hoëveldse wolke wat teen twee-uur al so swaar is, bluf nie.
lines.zu: Uma amafu aseHighveld esinda kangaka ngo-2 ntambama, awakhohlisi.
lines.xh: Xa amafu aseHighveld enzima kangaka ngo-2 emva kwemini, awakhohlisi.
lines.st: Ha maru a Highveld a le boima hakana ka 14:00, ha a thetse.

lines.en: Might rain. I've already cancelled everything, just in case.
lines.af: Dalk reën. Ek het klaar alles gekanselleer, net vir ingeval.
lines.zu: Imvula ingase ine. Sengihoxise konke, ngokuqapha nje.
lines.xh: Mhlawumbi iza kuna. Sele ndirhoxise yonke into, nje xa kunokwenzeka.
lines.st: Pula e ka na. Ke se ke hlakotse merero yohle, ke itshireletsa feela.

lines.en: The sky just said something. Nobody's arguing.
lines.af: Die lug het nou net iets gesê. Niemand stry nie.
lines.zu: Izulu lisanda kusho okuthile. Akekho ophikisayo.
lines.xh: Isibhakabhaka sisandula ukuthetha into. Akukho mntu uphikisayo.
lines.st: Lehodimo le sa tswa bua ntho e nngwe. Ha ho motho ya phehisang kgang.

lines.en: Hail. Every car owner in Gauteng just stood up.
lines.af: Hael. Elke kareienaar in Gauteng het pas opgestaan.
lines.zu: Isichotho. Wonke umnikazi wemoto eGauteng usanda kusukuma.
lines.xh: Isichotho. Wonke umnini wemoto eGauteng usandula ukuphakama.
lines.st: Sefako. Bohle ba nang le dikoloi Gauteng ba sa tswa ema ka maoto.

lines.en: The sky is throwing ice. Honestly, it feels personal.
lines.af: Die lug gooi ys. Eerlikwaar, dit voel persoonlik.
lines.zu: Isibhakabhaka siphonsa iqhwa. Ngeqiniso, sengathi sihlasela mina mathupha.
lines.xh: Isibhakabhaka siphosa umkhenkce. Ngokwenyani, ngathi sihlasela mna buqu.
lines.st: Lehodimo le lahla leqhwa. Ka nnete, ho tshwana le ha le hlasela nna ka bonna.

lines.en: UV this high, and even the shade wants shade.
lines.af: UV so hoog, selfs die skadu soek skadu.
lines.zu: Izinga le-UV liphezulu kangaka, ngisho nomthunzi ufuna umthunzi.
lines.xh: I-UV iphezulu kangangokuba nomthunzi ufuna umthunzi.
lines.st: UV e phahame hoo esita le moriti o batlang moriti.

lines.en: The sun's working overtime today, and billing your nose.
lines.af: Die son werk vandag oortyd, en jou neus kry die rekening.
lines.zu: Ilanga lisebenza isikhathi esengeziwe namuhla, futhi likhokhisa ikhala lakho.
lines.xh: Ilanga lisebenza ixesha elongezelelweyo namhlanje, kwaye ibhili iya empumlweni yakho.
lines.st: Letsatsi le sebetsa nako e eketsehileng kajeno, mme le lefisa nko ya hao.

lines.en: Barefoot to the car is an extreme sport today.
lines.af: Kaalvoet kar toe is vandag 'n ekstreme sport.
lines.zu: Ukuya emotweni ungafakile zicathulo kungumdlalo oyingozi kakhulu namuhla.
lines.xh: Ukuya emotweni ngaphandle kwezihlangu ngumdlalo oyingozi kakhulu namhlanje.
lines.st: Ho ya koloing o sa rwala dieta ke papadi e kotsi haholo kajeno.

lines.en: The wind has opinions and it's sharing every one.
lines.af: Die wind het opinies en deel elkeen.
lines.st: Moya o na le maikutlo, mme o re bolella ohle.

lines.en: Bright sun, frozen fingers. The sun's here for decoration.
lines.af: Helder son, bevrore vingers. Die son is net vir die mooi hier.
lines.zu: Ilanga liyakhanya, iminwe iqandile. Ilanga likhona nje ukuhlobisa.
lines.xh: Ilanga liqaqambile, iminwe ingumkhenkce. Ilanga likho nje ukuhombisa.
lines.st: Letsatsi le a kganya, menwana e hwame. Letsatsi le teng feela ho kgabisa.
